notes.title: "shadow heroes" V1.0.1 version has been updated

tags.feature: 1. The language option is added when entering the game for the first time, so that you can guide the novice more clearly;
2. The 4th and 5th levels have been updated, giving you more opportunities to challenge the difficulty;

tags.balance_change: 3. Some difficulties of the previous 1~3 levels have been adjusted;
4. Adjust the attack frequency and determination range of some available characters;
5. Adjust the way of holding the enemy and the attack interval of the long-range enemy;
6. Adjust the monster strength of the arena;

tags.bug: 7. Fixed the bug in the 80 level of the arena
